ABOUT ERAGON

Eragon is an Applied AI lab building an AI platform that powers self-improving agents for business enterprise. We’re working on memory, runtime, integrations, and product experience that make agents useful, reliable, and governable in real-world settings.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff, you’ll build across the Eragon product—from agent execution and tool use to the interfaces and infrastructure that make the system dependable. You’ll work on ambiguous, high-impact problems and leverage insights from research findings to help turn customer needs into shipped product.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design, build, and operate product and platform features across the agent lifecycle.

 - Improve how agents use context, models, tools, and connected business systems to complete tasks.

 - Build for reliability, observability, security, and clear user control.

 - Partner with design and customer-facing teammates to understand problems and ship useful solutions.

 - Help establish engineering practices that support fast iteration without sacrificing quality.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping production software.

 - Comfort working across systems and product surfaces, and making pragmatic technical tradeoffs.

 - Experience in AI/agent systems and interests in making them reliable and useful.

 - Clear communication, ownership, and a willingness to work through ambiguity.

 - TypeScript/Node.js experience is helpful; experience with enterprise software, integrations, or evaluation systems is a plus.
